name: Breadcrumbs
description: Adds a 'Breadcrumbs' Verso block that renders the navigation trail of the current page (Inicio › … › current page) with optional BreadcrumbList JSON-LD structured data for search engines. WordPress parity: Breadcrumb NavXT / Yoast Breadcrumbs.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its Verso block (in the editor and on public pages). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
